```{r imports, echo=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(Signac) #for the analysis of single-cell chromatin datasets
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86) #for a set of annotations for hg38
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(GenomeInfoDb)
```

## data import


```{r data import, echo = FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

Multiome_path <- "/data-pure/sequencing/ngs/NGS2026_10893/HG38/count/cellranger/GG001AC/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"
ATAC_fragments_info_path <- "/data-pure/sequencing/ngs/NGS2026_10893/HG38/count/cellranger/GG001AC/atac_fragments.tsv.gz"
ATAC_fragments_index_path <- "/data-pure/sequencing/ngs/NGS2026_10893/HG38/count/cellranger/GG001AC/atac_fragments.tsv.gz.tbi"

inputdata.10x <- Read10X_h5(Multiome_path)
# create a gene activity matrix from the peak matrix and GTF, using chromosomes 1:22, X, and Y.
# extract RNA and ATAC data
rna_counts <- inputdata.10x$`Gene Expression`
atac_counts <- inputdata.10x$Peaks

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = rna_counts)
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Now add in the ATAC-seq data
# we'll only use peaks in standard chromosomes
grange.counts <- StringToGRanges(rownames(atac_counts), sep = c(":", "-"))
grange.use <- seqnames(grange.counts) %in% standardChromosomes(grange.counts)
atac_counts <- atac_counts[as.vector(grange.use), ]
annotations <- GetGRangesFromEnsDb(ensdb = EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)
seqlevelsStyle(annotations) <- 'UCSC'
genome(annotations) <- "hg38"

frag.file <- ATAC_fragments_info_path
chrom_assay <- CreateChromatinAssay(
   counts = atac_counts,
   sep = c(":", "-"),
   genome = 'hg38',
   fragments = frag.file,
   min.cells = 10,
   annotation = annotations
 )
pbmc[["ATAC"]] <- chrom_assay

# Compute ATAC QC metrics
DefaultAssay(pbmc) <- "ATAC"
pbmc <- NucleosomeSignal(object = pbmc)
pbmc <- TSSEnrichment(object = pbmc, fast = FALSE)
```

## Title 2

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nCount_ATAC", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "TSS.enrichment", "nucleosome_signal"), ncol = 5,
  log = TRUE, pt.size = 0) + NoLegend()
```

```{r filter, echo=FALSE}
pbmc <- subset(
  x = pbmc,
  subset = nCount_ATAC < 7e4 &
    nCount_ATAC > 4e3 &
    nCount_RNA < 25000 &
    nCount_RNA > 500 &
    percent.mt < 5 &
    TSS.enrichment > 2 &
    nucleosome_signal < 2
)
```


```{r Future package Memory gestion, echo=FALSE}
# Load the future package (usually loaded with Seurat, but good to be explicit)
library(future)

# Increase max size to 4 GB (expressed in bytes: 4000 * 1024^2)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 4000 * 1024^2)
```


```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
# RNA analysis
#DefaultAssay(pbmc) <- "RNA"
#pbmc <- SCTransform(pbmc, verbose = FALSE) %>% RunPCA() %>% RunUMAP(dims = 1:50, reduction.name = 'umap.rna', reduction.key = 'rnaUMAP_')
DefaultAssay(pbmc) <- "RNA"
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc) %>% 
  FindVariableFeatures() %>% 
  ScaleData() %>% 
  RunPCA() %>% 
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:50, reduction.name = 'umap.rna', reduction.key = 'rnaUMAP_')

# ATAC analysis
# We exclude the first dimension as this is typically correlated with sequencing depth
DefaultAssay(pbmc) <- "ATAC"
pbmc <- RunTFIDF(pbmc)
pbmc <- FindTopFeatures(pbmc, min.cutoff = 'q0')
pbmc <- RunSVD(pbmc)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, reduction = 'lsi', dims = 2:50, reduction.name = "umap.atac", reduction.key = "atacUMAP_")
```
## Combination of RNA and ATAC modalities
```{r WNN graph, echo=FALSE}

pbmc <- FindMultiModalNeighbors(pbmc, reduction.list = list("pca", "lsi"), dims.list = list(1:50, 2:50))
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, nn.name = "weighted.nn", reduction.name = "wnn.umap", reduction.key = "wnnUMAP_")
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, graph.name = "wsnn", algorithm = 3, verbose = FALSE)
```


```{r Display graph, echo=FALSE}

p1 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap.rna", label = TRUE, label.size = 2.5, repel = TRUE) + ggtitle("RNA")
p2 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap.atac", label = TRUE, label.size = 2.5, repel = TRUE) + ggtitle("ATAC")
p3 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "wnn.umap", label = TRUE, label.size = 2.5, repel = TRUE) + ggtitle("WNN")
p1 + p2 + p3 & NoLegend() & theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```

```{r integrated file exploration}
source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IanevskiAleksandr/sc-type/master/R/sctype_wrapper.R"); 
pbmc <- run_sctype(pbmc, assay = "RNA", scaled = TRUE, known_tissue_type="Brain",custom_marker_file="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IanevskiAleksandr/sc-type/master/ScTypeDB_short.xlsx",name="sctype_classification")

DimPlot(pbmc, group.by = "sctype_classification", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, label.size = 2, label.box = TRUE)  + ggtitle("ScType") + theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 4), legend.spacing.x = unit(0.1, 'cm'), legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")) + guides(col = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2), ncol = 1))


```

```{r Display graph, echo=FALSE}

p1 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap.rna", group.by = "sctype_classification", label = TRUE, label.size = 2.5, repel = TRUE) + ggtitle("RNA")
p2 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap.atac", label = TRUE, label.size = 2.5, repel = TRUE) + ggtitle("ATAC")
p3 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "wnn.umap", group.by = "sctype_classification", label = TRUE, label.size = 2.5, repel = TRUE) + ggtitle("WNN")
p1 + p2 + p3 & NoLegend() & theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```
